Your career is a climbing wall, not a ladder, and the Career Center is here to support that winding path. Start now so that you grow and can fly out of the Owl’s Nest! Your career interests will evolve and change as you experience life at Temple and elsewhere. While these resources are organized into steps, they are available at any time. 

Explore

Identify and understand your unique qualities, learn about careers and how they relate to majors, and get to know the Career Center.

Explore

Grow

Launch your brand, write a resume and cover letter, learn how to network, and find internship opportunities.

Grow

Fly

Prepare to take flight! Apply to jobs, explore graduate or professional school, and ace the interview and hiring process.

Fly
